items.abstract: Ansible-HandsOn: Containerized Learning Environment Ansible-HandsOn is a lightweight, local lab environment designed for learning, testing, and mastering Ansible infrastructure automation. Instead of relying on resource-heavy Virtual Machines (VMs), this project leverages Docker containers to simulate a real-world network infrastructure in seconds.
